profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Datadog
profile.summary: Product-focused engineer with 9 years of experience shipping across the full stack. Experience as a VC-backed startup co-founder, team lead and manager, and senior IC at scale-ups through IPO.

positions.title: Co-Founder, Engineering
positions.locationName: Brooklyn, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Built and launched a creator licensing platform using Next.js and PostgreSQL that matched 4,000+ collectors and
generated $1.4MM in primary revenue, then raised $12MM in seed funding from a16z crypto
• Launched Avenue, a generative AI mobile app for interactive storytelling on iOS and Android using React Native
to 44,000+ unique users
• Developed LLM orchestration and prompt engineering for text and image generation pipelines, using a GraphQL
Fastify API on AWS (Fargate, Lambda, and SQS) to serve dynamic content from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Flux
• Designed and deployed an on-chain protocol for interactive narrative experiences using Deno and Fly.io VMs,
enabling revenue-sharing across creators, contributors, and participants. Also built a flow-based web interface for
non-technical authors to create branching narrative logic and test in real time.
• Prototyped and launched 10+ products, using direct user feedback to guide iteration and product direction
• Hired, managed, and mentored a remote team of 6 engineers, balancing technical leadership with execution

positions.title: Engineering Manager, Android Mobile / TV
positions.description:
• Led a 12-person cross-functional team of Android engineers and QA to deliver bi-weekly releases, partnering with PMs and cross-team stakeholders to drive alignment across Android platform and architecture groups
• Increased Android app feature parity with iOS from 50% to 90% within one year by prioritizing high-impact feature gaps while balancing new product development alongside parity work
• Established scalable release and development workflows with GitHub and custom Slack integrations to support a multi-team Android codebase during a framework migration to reduce deployment friction

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Android Mobile / TV
positions.description:
• Developed and launched Android Mobile and Fire TV applications in React Native to 100,000+ users
• Planned and led migration of Android and Fire TV apps to native Kotlin, improving startup time by 60% (4s) and integrating with Peloton’s Android monorepo
• Rewrote Android Mobile and TV video streaming experience in Kotlin as a part of app performance migration and consolidated video analytics across all Android devices, reducing streaming errors by 40%

positions.title: Software Engineer, Web Product
positions.description:
• Led launch preparation, testing, and hardening for Peloton class streaming React web application; previously classes were only available on iOS and proprietary hardware
• Introduced RUM observability for Web content using New Relic, enabling real-time alerting and simpler debugging

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built new Draft Experience as a greenfield React app, improving maintainability while reducing load time by 20%
• Led migration of email service provider in a .NET microservice, lowering costs and improving reliability
• Developed universal navigation system in React, Redux, and ES6 used across the DraftKings ecosystem

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:
• Built front-end experiences with on top of WordPress, Drupal, and Laravel
• Utilized build tools and frameworks, such as Grunt.js, Bower, SASS, and Foundation
• Collaborated with team via Git repositories with code reviews, and CI/CD with Deploy

positions.title: Marketing Intern
positions.description:
• Integrated a link tracking tool to team’s current workflow with a JavaScript Chrome extension and reduced time by 60%
• Led an attempt to expand in-house video library by building a HTML/CSS prototype and presenting to team
• Created, altered, and stylized HTML/CSS for CMS templates in use in upcoming marketing campaigns

positions.title: Technology Technician
positions.description:
• Provided technical support and advice for over 400 full-time and 300 part-time employees
• Interacted and assisted high-importance athletics individuals, such as the athletic directors and head football coach
• Managed software systems and applications for over 900 computers with Absolute Manage

positions.title: Technology Intern
positions.description:
• Constructed a custom web CMS on a Python/Django/MySQL/CentOS stack
• Provided single point of collection for team information; previously housed in several obscure data stores
• Led team to fundraise over $600,000 for cancer research and support systems
• Rode bike from Austin, TX to Anchorage, AK to promote cancer awareness
• Organized and ran a first-time golf tournament that raised over $6,000 for cancer research

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin

projects.title: Mr. Spirit 2016 iOS Application
projects.description: The Mr. Spirit 2016 iOS app allowed audience members to view the bios of each individual candidate in the talent show, as well as allowing them to cast votes in their candidate of choice's favor and donate to The Make-A-Wish Foundation and Saint Louise House. The application utilized the Firebase API to record votes and candidate data, and the Braintree API to process payments.

projects.title: Half Court Press
projects.description: Half Court Press is a single-paged, muliti-view Angular.js web application that harnesses the NBA's open REST API to deliver daily fantasy sports (DraftKings and FanDuel) results. The application is hosted on GitHub pages and utilizes AWS API Gateway to neutralize CORS errors resulting from cross-domain browser access.

organizations.name: Texas 4000 for Cancer
organizations.position: Fundraising and Business Development Chair · Sep 2013 - Aug 2014
